title: HSE-type hybrids must not reuse the RPA/GW massidda singularity correction or exx_hybrid_step=2
symptom: 'HSE never converges' on MnTe DZP nspin=2.
root_cause: The massidda singularity correction and the debug-oriented exx_hybrid_step=2 belong to the RPA/GW chain; a hybrid self-consistent loop needs its own treatment.
minimal_fix: Run HSE with exx_singularity_correction != massidda and a production exx_hybrid_step; encode the rule in the version-guard/merge-compat reference so new HSE inputs are checked before submission.
validation: ...-nomassidda-nodebugstep run converged with a physical near-gap (2.149 eV).
avoid: Reusing GW/RPA defaults wholesale for hybrid SCF.
